<defs>
      <linearGradient id="gr" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#55a675"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#3f8a5f"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#2b6745"/></linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id="rd" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#e9694f"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#d9503a"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#ad3826"/></linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id="gd" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#f4c65e"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#e6a52e"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#c0821b"/></linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id="cl" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#cd8a5f"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#b7714a"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#8c5334"/></linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id="brass" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#e8c98a"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#c69a4e"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#8f6c2e"/></linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id="stone" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#e2d9c6"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#c9bfa8"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#a89d86"/></linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id="wood" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#d5a06f"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#b7714a"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#8c5334"/></linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id="roofR" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#e9694f"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#ad3826"/></linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id="roofG" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#55a675"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#2b6745"/></linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id="wall" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#fbf6ea"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#e9dfc9"/></linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id="path" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#e3d6bb"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#d3c4a6"/></linearGradient>
      <radialGradient id="lampG"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffd98a" stop-opacity=".9"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffd98a" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient>
      <radialGradient id="fogM"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#f6efe1" stop-opacity=".85"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#f6efe1" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient>

      <!-- one bot, reused. hard hat + tool belt on the accepted machine bot -->
      <g id="bot">
        <g class="body">
          <g class="leg leg-l"><path d="M-14 74 v26" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="11" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M-20 98 h14" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/></g>
          <g class="leg leg-r"><path d="M14 74 v26" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="11" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M8 98 h14" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/></g>
          <path class="torso" d="M-26 2 q0 -22 26 -22 q26 0 26 22 v44 q0 26 -26 26 q-26 0 -26 -26 z" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="6" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
          <path d="M8 -19 q18 4 18 21 v44 q0 26 -26 26 q-6 0 -11 -2 q19 -4 19 -26 z" fill="#221f1c" opacity=".14"/>
          <path d="M-17 -8 q-5 8 -5 22 v20" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="6" opacity=".3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
          <rect x="-14" y="14" width="28" height="22" rx="7" fill="#efe6d4" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="4"/>
          <circle class="chest" cx="0" cy="25" r="4.8"/>
          <!-- tool belt -->
          <rect x="-27" y="42" width="54" height="10" rx="4" fill="url(#wood)" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="4"/>
          <rect x="6" y="40" width="12" height="16" rx="3" fill="url(#brass)" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="3.5"/>
          <g class="arm arm-l"><path d="M-25 10 q-21 11 -20 34" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="9" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="hand" cx="-45" cy="47" r="9" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="5"/></g>
          <g class="arm arm-r"><path d="M25 10 q21 11 20 34" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="9" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="hand" cx="45" cy="47" r="9" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="5"/></g>
          <rect x="-13" y="-26" width="26" height="9" rx="4" fill="url(#brass)" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="4"/>
          <g class="head">
            <path d="M-30 -62 q0 -14 12 -14 h36 q12 0 12 14 v22 q0 14 -12 14 h-36 q-12 0 -12 -14 z" fill="#f6efe1" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="6" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
            <path d="M18 -76 q12 0 12 14 v22 q0 14 -12 14 h-9 q11 -4 11 -18 v-14 q0 -14 -11 -18 z" fill="#221f1c" opacity=".12"/>
            <rect x="-21" y="-56" width="42" height="24" rx="12" fill="#221f1c"/>
            <circle class="glow" cx="-8" cy="-44" r="10" opacity=".3"/><circle class="glow" cx="8" cy="-44" r="10" opacity=".3"/>
            <circle class="eye" cx="-8" cy="-44" r="4.6"/><circle class="eye" cx="8" cy="-44" r="4.6"/>
            <path d="M-17 -53 q6 -3 13 -2" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="4" opacity=".3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
            <!-- hard hat -->
            <path d="M-36 -74 q0 -30 36 -30 q36 0 36 30 z" fill="url(#gd)" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="6" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
            <rect x="-42" y="-78" width="84" height="10" rx="5" fill="url(#gd)" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="5"/>
            <path d="M-22 -92 q10 -6 24 -6" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="5" opacity=".35" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
          </g>
        </g>
      </g>

      <!-- a sealed crate -->
      <g id="crate">
        <rect x="-38" y="-26" width="76" height="52" rx="7" fill="url(#wood)" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="5"/>
        <rect x="-38" y="-26" width="76" height="52" rx="7" fill="url(#plank)"/>
        <path d="M-38 -4 h76" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="4" opacity=".5"/>
        <path d="M-10 -26 v52 M10 -26 v52" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="3" opacity=".35"/>
        <path d="M-38 -6 h76" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="5" stroke-dasharray="7 5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <circle cx="0" cy="-6" r="12" fill="url(#rd)" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="4"/>
        <text x="0" y="-1" text-anchor="middle" class="sealtext" font-size="11">VV</text>
      </g>
    </defs>

<g transform="translate(760 600)" data-arch>
        <ellipse cx="0" cy="10" rx="230" ry="18" fill="#221f1c" opacity=".12"/>

        <g transform="translate(-190 0)">
          <rect x="-34" y="-60" width="68" height="60" rx="8" fill="url(#stone)" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="6"/>

        <g transform="translate(190 0)">

        </g></g>
        <text x="0" y="46" text-anchor="middle" class="lbl">THE GATE</text>

hall:
<g transform="translate(2330 600) scale(.86)" data-hall>
        <ellipse cx="40" cy="10" rx="330" ry="20" fill="#221f1c" opacity=".13"/>
        <!-- plinth -->
        <rect x="-290" y="-24" width="580" height="24" rx="6" fill="url(#stone)" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="6"/>
        <path d="M-290 -12 h580" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="3" opacity=".35"/>
        <!-- walls -->
        <rect x="-260" y="-230" width="520" height="206" rx="10" fill="url(#wall)" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="6"/>
        <rect x="150" y="-230" width="110" height="206" fill="#221f1c" opacity=".08"/>
        <!-- stone corners -->
        <g fill="url(#stone)" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="4">
          <rect x="-266" y="-70" width="34" height="22" rx="5"/><rect x="-266" y="-118" width="26" height="22" rx="5"/><rect x="-266" y="-166" width="34" height="22" rx="5"/>
          <rect x="232" y="-70" width="34" height="22" rx="5"/><rect x="240" y="-118" width="26" height="22" rx="5"/><rect x="232" y="-166" width="34" height="22" rx="5"/>
        </g>
        <!-- big roof -->
        <path d="M-330 -220 L0 -420 L330 -220 Z" fill="url(#roofG)" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="7" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        <path d="M-290 -222 L0 -396 L290 -222" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="6" opacity=".16"/>
        <path d="M-330 -220 H330" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="7"/>

        <g transform="translate(0 -420)"><path d="M0 0 v-70" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><path class="flag" d="M2 -70 l58 12 l-58 14 z" fill="url(#rd)" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round"/></g>
        <!-- steps -->
        <rect x="-100" y="0" width="200" height="12" rx="4" fill="url(#stone)" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="5"/>
        <!-- roof sign -->
        <g transform="translate(0 -250)">
          <rect x="-150" y="-26" width="300" height="52" rx="10" fill="url(#wood)" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="6"/>
          <rect x="-150" y="-26" width="300" height="52" fill="url(#plank)"/>
          <text x="0" y="9" text-anchor="middle" class="signmid">EXAM HALL</text>
        </g>
        <!-- the sealed double doors -->
        <g transform="translate(0 -24)">
          <rect x="-72" y="-140" width="144" height="140" rx="40" ry="20" fill="url(#wood)" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="6"/>
          <rect x="-72" y="-140" width="144" height="140" rx="40" ry="20" fill="url(#plank)"/>
          <path d="M0 -140 v140" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="5"/>
          <path d="M-60 -70 h120" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="10 8"/>
          <g class="seal"><circle cx="0" cy="-70" r="22" fill="url(#rd)" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="5"/><text x="0" y="-64" text-anchor="middle" class="sealtext">VV</text></g>
          <text x="0" y="-14" text-anchor="middle" class="stamp">SEALED</text>
        </g>
        <!-- the judge's window, lit -->
        <g transform="translate(-170 -140)">
          <circle cx="0" cy="10" r="70" fill="url(#lampG)" opacity=".8"/>
          <rect x="-56" y="-48" width="112" height="96" rx="12" fill="#ffe6bb" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="6"/>

          <g transform="translate(0 22) scale(.5)">
            <rect x="-70" y="10" width="140" height="18" rx="6" fill="url(#wood)" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="5"/>
            <path d="M-40 12 q10 -42 40 -42 q30 0 40 42 z" fill="url(#gr)" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="6" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
            <circle cx="0" cy="-44" r="27" fill="#f0cfa8" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="6"/>
            <path d="M-27 -52 q5 -27 27 -27 q23 0 27 27 q-14 -11 -27 -9 q-17 2 -27 9z" fill="#3a2f28" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
            <circle cx="-10" cy="-42" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="4"/><circle cx="10" cy="-42" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="4"/><path d="M-1 -42 h2" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="4"/>
            <circle class="eye" cx="-10" cy="-42" r="3.4" fill="#221f1c"/><circle class="eye" cx="10" cy="-42" r="3.4" fill="#221f1c"/>
            <path d="M-8 -30 q8 4 16 0" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
            <rect x="-50" y="-4" width="34" height="22" rx="3" fill="#f6efe1" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="4" class="paper"/>
            <g class="stamphand"><rect x="18" y="-14" width="22" height="26" rx="5" fill="url(#rd)" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="4"/></g>
          </g>
          <path d="M-56 0 h112" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="4" opacity=".5"/>
          <text x="0" y="-58" text-anchor="middle" class="lbl">THE JUDGE</text>
        </g>
        <!-- lantern by the door -->
        <g transform="translate(120 -150)">
          <circle cx="0" cy="24" r="38" fill="url(#lampG)" class="lamp"/>
          <path d="M-18 -10 h36" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="5"/><path d="M0 -10 v10" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="4"/>
          <rect x="-13" y="0" width="26" height="34" rx="6" fill="#ffe6bb" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="5"/>
          <rect x="-16" y="-4" width="32" height="8" rx="3" fill="url(#brass)" stroke="#221f1c" stroke-width="4"/>
        </g>
        <text x="0" y="46" text-anchor="middle" class="lbl">THE EXAM HALL · FORGE</text>
      </g>
